label: early copy-phase steps (outputs 1-3) of long sequences, strongest when echoing b/j/z/n
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never during original input or on <DEL>. Almost all mass sits at the first few copy steps after <DEL> (recall_idx 1-3, peak at 2, i.e. input = fed-back orig(0..2)) in long sequences (L=9 gives 80% of mass, L=8 17%, never for L<=5). Within that window, the input token strongly sets magnitude: b is by far the strongest (top activations are b at recall_idx 2), then j, z, n, then 0, f, i, 1; other tokens give weak activations. The structural window alone (recall_idx 1-3, L>=8) covers 95% of mass but with precision 0.12; adding the b/j/z/n token set gives F1 about 0.51 on dev. Small tail at the last copy steps (recall_idx 7-8) of L=9. Activation is graded by token and position, so no single boolean captures it cleanly.
